title: papaver dubium subsp. collinum
intro: Papaver dubium subsp. collinum, commonly known as the Himalayan poppy, is a plant species within the Papaver genus. It is a flowering plant with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Papaver dubium subsp. collinum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesia, anti-anxiety, and sedation.
